result:
**Verdict: FAIL** for DG0 round 21, candidate `sha256:7d00f857…` (commit 9e3c27f). The fixes for my four round-20 findings work, but the new tolerance they added lets some invalid gate evidence through, so I raised one new Medium finding.

**New finding**
- **F-DG0-245 (Medium, not a mandatory violation; owner delivery-orchestrator).** The new rule that skips checks on commits that no longer exist doesn't check why they're missing. It applies in every round, including the gate round, and to any value.
  - **Run start commit:** a gate-round review or audit run is accepted when its recorded start commit is missing, null, the runner's own fallback `unknown`, or a made-up id. This held for all four roles, 16 of 16 variants.
  - **Regression:** that brings back two cases (QA5-N52 and QA5-N53) that my round-9 suite rejected up to round 20. They exist to prove a run started after the candidate was frozen.
  - **Fix pointers:** a closed finding whose fix commit id doesn't exist (a one-character typo, or all zeros) is accepted in the gate round. The existing unit test for this change actually treats the all-zeros case as acceptable, and no unit test covers the run-start check.
  - **Exposure:** exploiting it needs the orchestrator to tamper with the run record before it's committed (the risk the threat model already admits as residual 1), or a runner fault. Every other link between a run and its review still holds.
  - **Fix:** skip the check only for a well-formed 40-character id in a round whose own commit is also missing. On the real history that changes nothing for runs. Only F-DG0-226/227/228 would need their fix commit moved to a commit that still exists, as was done for F-DG0-150/151.

**Round-20 findings, all verified and closed (CLOSED_VERIFIED)**
- **F-DG0-242:** the dry-run gate on a fresh clone now shows 0 errors for missing commits, orphaned review files or dropped findings (263 errors in round 20). The 58 that remain only mean round 21 isn't finished yet. A fix commit that exists but isn't in the candidate is still rejected. The 64 missing fix commits are also absent from the original repository, so none of them sits on another branch.
- **F-DG0-243:** a review file left by an interrupted run can't close a finding or hide an open High one. If that role's record file exists but isn't listed, it's still an error.
- **F-DG0-241:** a gate commit on another branch, a tag, a missing id or a tree id are all rejected.
- **F-DG0-244:** all 96 fix commit ids are full 40-character ids. The round-19 and round-20 test evidence is committed. F-DG0-150/151 now point at `421c922…`, which is on the branch and has a byte-identical `agent_sandbox.py`.

**Other checks (all passed unless noted)**
- The seven required commands, including gate tests 58/58 and agent tests 39/39.
- The candidate ID matches, and only the five stated files changed since round 20.
- `prefreeze.sh DG0` in a fresh clone.
- Reverting `rules.mjs` to the round-20 version makes the three new unit tests fail, as it should.
- My independent check of the requirements register: 412 rows, 0 errors, none VERIFIED.
- Agent setup: 10 distinct runs, all on the orchestrator's model, with out-of-scope writes blocked.
- The acceptance map covers all 28 scenarios (A01–A28).
- The live Write-tool attempt on `docs/source/QA-PROBE.txt` was blocked by the write guard.
- The standard A24/A25 rejection list still holds.
- **Not run (BLOCKED):** the shell-level write probe. The session's permission classifier refused it and I didn't retry. The round-20 live probe and the sandbox tests are the remaining evidence.

My round-20 suite also shows three failures for the old gate-commit cases, but only because the error wording changed. Those cases are still rejected, so they aren't defects.

I didn't modify any product files, and I didn't open the domain-reviewer's run evidence that was committed during my run.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG0/round-21/qa-verifier.json` (schema-valid)
- `reviews/DG0/round-21/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG0/round-21/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG0/qa/round-21/` (12 logs)
- `test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/dg0-gate-negative-r21.test.mjs` (new tests)
